key_insight: HiFi-Inpaint introduces a reference-based inpainting approach that preserves high-frequency product details in human-product images by explicitly aligning and transferring fine-grained features from product reference images.
problem_solved: Generates realistic human-product images while overcoming common failures of prior inpainting methods: loss of product texture/detail, poor cross-image alignment, and limited reference-driven fidelity.
method: Reference-guided alignment: match and align features between the target (human image) and product reference to locate transferable detail.
Detail-preserving synthesis: fuse multi-scale features with specialized modules and high-frequency/texture-aware losses to retain fine textures during inpainting.
Training & evaluation with curated reference pairs and fidelity-focused metrics to emphasize visual detail preservation.
impact: Provides a practical solution for producing high-fidelity human-product images for advertising, e-commerce and virtual try-on, and supplies techniques practitioners can adopt to improve texture fidelity in generative vision models.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: target image + product reference → alignment module → detail-preserving inpainting → final output
Before/after zoom-ins: close-ups of product regions showing texture recovery and edge preservation
Attention/feature maps: visualizing cross-image alignment and where detail is transferred
Bar chart or table: fidelity-focused metrics (e.g., perceptual/texture scores) comparing HiFi-Inpaint vs. baselines
paper_title: HiFi-Inpaint: Towards High-Fidelity Reference-Based Inpainting for Generating Detail-Preserving Human-Product Images
paper_authors: Yichen Liu, Donghao Zhou, Jie Wang, Xin Gao, Guisheng Liu
